<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/extrinsics"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns all extrinsics from the database that satisfy the query parameters. It will return a paginated response, ordered descending by block number, then ascending extrinsic index.
